about: WHAT A DYING BOAR LETS GO OF, for the game to throw (16.11): each type's own helmet or cap (helmet_<type>, drawn by src/render/paint/boarArmy.ts in place of the stand-in props.png helmets) and the gear the painted death frames show flying for one frame (<type>_<thing>: not thrown by the game yet). Cut by tools/haifa/boar_atlas2.py from the painted loose pieces, as painted (no turn). texels = image px a shown art px (32 art px a cell); rects = [x, y, w, h] image px; lie = the turn in radians (counter-clockwise) at which the piece rests on the floor.
